t: Into The Omegaverse: How a Fanfic Trope Landed in Federal Court

q.x: To the contrary, there have been many cases of very similar novels with largely identical plot points and settings that survive copyright allegations, even if the author was exposed to the original work.

recs.stt: Proctorio used DMCA to take down a student’s critical tweets
recs.x: If you have some time and don't mind indirectly learning about less conventional areas of the romance genre, I recommend watching Lindsay Ellis' two pieces on misuse of copyright law to harass critics: Into The Omegaverse: How a Fanfic Trope Landed in Federal Court [link] and the follow-up that roped the EFF into a battle over ABO: [link]
